description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain offering by-the-slice and whole pies for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The Cambie Street location sits on a major urban cycling corridor in Vancouver's Cambie Village neighbourhood, making it a convenient quick-stop for hungry riders. Vegetarian toppings are available across the menu.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 12m; building (12 spaces, covered, paid) at 32m; rack at 34m; wall_loops (6 spaces) at 42m; stands (7 spaces) at 90m. Total: 29 spaces.
